Stuck in arguments that sound holy but breed strife? Check the root. (1 Timothy 6:3–5 devotional)

Some teaching sounds right but grows quarrels around it. Paul says you spot the counterfeit by its fruit — and its root is godliness bent into a means of gain. True teaching builds people up; falsehood breeds strife.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
